messages.text: I found your stainless steel cookware set. It hasn’t been recorded as received back by the shop, and refunds can only proceed for items the shop has received (refund-policy/v1/return). If you’ve already sent it back, tell me and I can arrange for a staff member to check.
I haven’t sent it back. How can I return it?

messages.text: I don’t have return instructions or a label available here. Your order is still marked as shipped, and this refund process only applies once an order is delivered and the shop has received the item back (refund-policy/v1/eligible-orders; refund-policy/v1/return). Please wait for delivery, then contact us for help with the return.
Is there anything I can do to cancel the order or stop the delivery before it arrives?
